product_truth_conflicts: Do not reproduce the goal's historical global navigation tabs or utility icons.
Do not restore real league logos from the historical goal.
Current main league order wins over the goal's apparent segment order.
Use project-original league marks and the later monochrome wheel direction.
Preserve current main wheel timing, accessibility, BACK lockout, persistence and selected/locked behavior.
recommended_fidelity_order: Move production onto the cinematic stadium/manager stage instead of reskinning the flat panel.
Pin the wheel to the target plate anchor and correct R8.43's left/up/oversize drift.
Replace multicolour wheel marks with the monochrome pale-on-dark and near-black-on-gold language.
Restore rough brush title character while keeping semantic DOM text.
Register Daniel's fingertip precisely above the rim.
Move desktop actions upward and restore intended control height.
Use current shared chrome instead of historical goal navigation.
Recompose phone around a 220-250 CSS px wheel and prove 360x640 no-scroll and 375x553 primary-action visibility.
conclusion: R8.43 is already close as a visual proposal and mainly needs precision, title-language, monochrome-mark and mobile corrections. Current production main is still the old flat spinner/panel composition, so the live-production fidelity gap remains critical.
